title: Refunds
subtitle:
Money owed back to customers. A registered member is credited to their balance automatically; a guest is
            transferred by hand from here.
emptyDescription: Refund requests will appear here once customers ask for one.
emptyFilteredDescription: Nothing matches the current filters. Try a different search or clear the filters.
settlementNotReversed:
The merchant settlement for this sale was not reversed — usually because they had already withdrawn
                  the money. The customer was refunded regardless; chase the shortfall with the merchant.
payoutSubtitle:
Enter the account the customer gave you. This is recorded as supplied by an admin, not confirmed by the
              customer.
rejectRefundHint:
No money moves and the sale still stands. The claim link stops working, so the customer cannot submit
              payout details afterwards.
rejectRefundPlaceholder: e.g. Duplicate claim — already refunded under RFD-…
rejectClaimHint:
The refund stays owed. The account is detached and a new claim link is sent to the email on
              the original order, so the real buyer can still claim it.
rejectClaimPlaceholder: e.g. Account contact does not match the order
searchPlaceholder: Refund no., invoice no., email or phone
verifyHint: The balance is credited immediately and the order is marked refunded. This cannot be undone from here.
verifyPlaceholder: e.g. Contact matched, order history consistent
completeHint: Confirm only after the money has actually left. This closes the refund and marks the order as refunded.
hintWaitingAccount: Owed, but the customer has not made an account yet
hintPending: An account is attached — waiting for someone to check it
hintProcessing: An admin has claimed it and is verifying
